messages:
Elena: Onboarding orion-lite int5 (compact) — quick smoke shows invisible chars (NBSP/ZWJ) between Han+furigana when Arabic/Hebrew present later. BLEU down ~6 on srt-multilang. Anyone seen quant compaction cause this? :thinking:

Mateo: Can you paste a tiny repro + quant flags? Token ids/raw hex would help.

Elena: Repro: ./eval --model orion-lite --quant int5 --calib per_channel --quant-hash=fnv --dataset srt-multilang --langs ja,zh,ar,he --detok unicode
Sample fp16 detok: "章フリガナ"
int5 detok: "章 フリガナ" (NBSP inserted). Raw dump shows 0xC2 0xA0 between E4 B8 B0 and E3 83 95 when a RTL mark appears later.

Satoshi: Sounds like tokenmap collision or normalizer mismatch. Try --tokenizer-normalize=NFKC and regen table with --quant-hash=xxh3 --quant-salt=9.

Elena: Quick try: NFKC removes many cases but BLEU still ~3 down. Regenerated xxh3+9 on single worker — NBSP disappears in sample and BLEU improves to -1.2 delta. Filed BUG-ml-8209 with repro + tokenmap_int5.json. Temporarily blocked orion-lite_int5 auto-promote.

Mateo: Good. Add a small mixed-script unit (kanji+furigana + RTL fragment) to quant smoke harness and gate compaction changes. If xxh3+salt fixes consistently, switch default compaction hash and regen affected tables.

eval-bot: Snapshot: fp16 BLEU 40.9 -> int5 BLEU 34.9 | int5(regen xxh3+9) BLEU 39.6. CI jobs queued for regen grid.

Elena: Thanks — I'll follow up with CI results and attach failing lines to the bug.
